The most wins at the World Team Badminton Championships (female) is 16, achieved by China in 1984, 1986, 1988, 1990, 1992, 1998, 2000, 2002, 2004, 2006, 2008, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2021 and 2024.
The Uber Cup or World Women's Team Championships was instituted in 1956. China won a record-extending 16th title on 5 May 2024, defeating Indonesia 3–0 in the final in Chengdu, China.
